# AI Foundation Requirements Checklist: AI Foundation Cleanup & Spec Alignment

**Purpose**: Validate whether the 09C requirements and plan are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable enough to implement one canonical AI foundation without preserving duplicate architecture.
**Created**: 2026-05-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the criteria for selecting the canonical AI orchestration path fully documented, including required ownership of credits, AI runs, provider selection, output validation, persistence, and audit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK002 Are all legacy AI path categories that must be inspected explicitly covered, including controllers, services, provider adapters/factories, DTOs, tests, contracts, docs, and frontend consumers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §Legacy AI Path]
- [x] CHK003 Are the allowed outcomes for legacy code complete enough to guide implementation: removed, compatibility wrapper, renamed/adapted, or documented deprecated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §Legacy AI Path]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for preserving every 09A/09B behavior that matters: estimate, scenario generation, test-case generation, run-status metadata, credits, audit, structured drafts, and access validation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-012-FR-015]
- [x] CHK005 Are documentation update requirements complete across specs, status, API design, architecture, roadmap, and run report expectations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017-FR-018, Plan §Project Structure]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "one clear canonical AI orchestration path" defined with enough precision to distinguish acceptable shared helpers from a second active architecture? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Phase 0]
- [x] CHK007 Is "legacy duplicate AI path" clarified so implementers know whether duplicate tests and docs count as legacy surface, not only production classes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §Legacy AI Path]
- [x] CHK008 Is "safe removal" defined by objective evidence such as no active frontend consumer, migrated tests, passing validation, and updated docs? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Contract §Legacy Compatibility Contract]
- [x] CHK009 Is "compatibility wrapper" specified tightly enough to prohibit independent prompt construction, provider selection, credit writes, AI run writes, and unvalidated provider output? [Clarity, Plan §Note, Contract §Legacy Compatibility Contract]
- [x] CHK010 Are "backend tests pass" and "frontend lint, tests and build pass" scoped to concrete validation commands or documented equivalents? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019-FR-020, Quickstart §2-§3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are spec, plan, research, data model, and contract consistent that AI Test Design is the canonical path unless implementation finds a safer documented alternative? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Phase 0, Research §Canonical AI orchestration path]
- [x] CHK012 Do legacy compatibility requirements align with the no-duplicate-architecture success criterion, avoiding permission to keep intact legacy behavior indefinitely? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, Contract §Legacy Compatibility Contract]
- [x] CHK013 Are frontend requirements consistent across documents that `apps/web` calls only backend product APIs and never provider APIs or secrets? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006-FR-008, Contract §Frontend Contract]
- [x] CHK014 Are test requirements consistent that automated tests use only mock/deterministic provider behavior and never a real provider? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009-FR-010, Plan §Testing, Contract §Test Contract]
- [x] CHK015 Are out-of-scope constraints consistent across spec and plan, especially no new AI features, no Check-up MVP, no billing purchase flow, no streaming, no provider expansion, no redesign, and no microservices? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Constraints]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can SC-001 be objectively measured by tracing all active AI generation flows to the documented canonical path? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK017 Can SC-002 be objectively evaluated by requiring every remaining duplicate/conflicting path to have an explicit removal, wrapper, adaptation, or deprecation rationale? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK018 Are SC-004 and SC-005 measurable through source/bundle/test inspection criteria rather than relying on informal review? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004-SC-005, Quickstart §4]
- [x] CHK019 Is SC-006 measurable enough to prove tests use mock provider behavior without requiring network/provider credentials? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Contract §Test Contract]
- [x] CHK020 Are SC-007 and SC-008 tied to validation coverage for credit handling, AI run tracking, audit behavior, structured output validation, and AI UI regression? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-007-SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Are primary cleanup scenarios covered for identifying, deciding, and normalizing competing backend AI paths? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK022 Are compatibility scenarios covered for endpoints still used by frontend or tests, including how requirements should treat temporary wrappers? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Legacy Compatibility Contract]
- [x] CHK023 Are preservation scenarios covered for existing Workspace AI estimate/generation UX without introducing new UI or feature scope? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK024 Are documentation/status scenarios covered for explaining what was removed, preserved, adapted, deprecated, and why? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK025 Are exception scenarios covered for provider failure, output-validation failure, insufficient credits, and access denial as requirements quality concerns rather than only implementation tests? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012-FR-015, Plan §Testing]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the case where a legacy endpoint has no frontend consumer but still has backend tests or docs referencing it? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §Legacy endpoint handling]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for the case where a legacy class contains reusable logic that should move into canonical modules instead of being deleted wholesale? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Legacy AI Path]
- [x] CHK028 Are requirements defined for handling stale documentation that lists planned future AI endpoints beside active canonical endpoints? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Docs Gap]
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for accidental provider-real configuration during automated tests, including how the requirements should make this impossible or detectable? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Test Contract]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for raw provider payloads or prompts accidentally leaking through safe run metadata or compatibility responses? [Edge Case, Contract §GET /api/ai/runs/{aiRunId}, Contract §Legacy Compatibility Contract]

- [x] CHK031 Are security requirements complete for provider secret handling, frontend exposure, safe run metadata, and server-side provider selection? [Security, Spec §FR-006-FR-010, Contract §Frontend Contract]
- [x] CHK032 Are privacy/LGPD-sensitive data requirements clear enough to avoid exposing prompts, raw provider payloads, secrets, or unnecessary context in frontend responses and docs? [Security, Spec §QA Artifact Impact, Contract §GET /api/ai/runs/{aiRunId}]
